title: UK CPI, October 2027 (ONS, 07:00 London) — the second, upward VAT base effect nobody diarised, thirteen months after the cut
source: EST: ons.gov.uk release calendar, swept across all 37 pages of upcoming releases direct on 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the entry reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: October 2027 | Release date: 17 November 2027 7:00am | Provisional'. ONS's own label is Provisional, which is the honest reason for `estimate` on top of the standing schema gap: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for ONS. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01 LANE, 2026-09-09, AND IT IS THE FINDING THAT LANE EXISTS FOR. The GB domestic-electricity zero rate (SI 2026/987) runs 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31, which puts FOUR dated VAT steps in the UK CPI year-on-year path, not two: the drag APPEARS in the October 2026 print (published 2026-11-18), persists to March 2027, DROPS OUT in the April 2027 print (published 2027-05-19), and then a symmetric UPWARD base effect APPEARS IN THIS PRINT and runs through March 2028 -- because October 2027 measures a normal-rated month against a ZERO-RATED BASE month. Size: about +5.0% year-on-year on the CPI electricity index from VAT alone, roughly +0.09 to +0.13pp on headline (the band is the undrawn 2027 weight; ONS series CJXA ranged 19.1488 to 27.0 per 1000 across 2023-2026). NOTHING ON THIS CALENDAR WAS CARRYING THIS STEP, which is the whole argument for the entry: by November 2027 every commentator who diarised the October 2026 cut is thirteen months past it, and a UK autumn-2027 print running ~0.1pp hot will read as re-acceleration when it is a base effect. ATTRIBUTION RULE: check the ONS contributions table for the electricity contribution before treating an autumn 2027 UK upside surprise as inflation news. Registered as FT-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01-3, score by 2027-11-17. VOIDED IF THE ZERO RATE IS EXTENDED beyond 2027-03-31 (FT-...-1, score by 2027-03-31), since an extension removes the zero-rated base -- in which case this entry should be re-noted or dropped rather than researched as a VAT event. NOTE ON OWNERSHIP: the proposing lane's own ledger closes out within six days of 2027-04-01 and goes quiet, so it cannot score this itself; that is precisely why the venue is proposed as its own calendar entry.
